intro.en: Holy is an old English word for something set apart for God.
intro.cn: holy 是古英语词，指为神而分别出来、归于神圣的事物。

items.cn: hailag 意为神圣的、完整的。

items.en: Holy describes places, days, and people.
items.cn: holy 用来描述地点、日子和人。
holiday 由 holy day 演变而来。

note.en: Holy is compared with look-alike words and with words for the sacred.
note.cn: 把 holy 与形近词以及表示神圣的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Holy describes what people set apart for God.
normalIntro.cn: holy 描述人们为神而分别出来、格外敬重的事物。

normal.en: This old temple is considered holy.
normal.cn: 这座古庙被认为是神圣的。

normal.en: Pilgrims walked slowly across the holy ground.
normal.cn: 朝圣者慢慢走过圣地。

normal.en: The holy book is read every morning.
normal.cn: 每天早上都诵读圣书。

normal.en: She lived a holy and simple life.
normal.cn: 她过着圣洁而简朴的生活。

normal.en: Sunday was once a holy day for the village.
normal.cn: 星期天曾是村里的圣日。

abstract.en: Holy is a word for what is set apart, not for what is merely old.
abstract.cn: 神圣说的是被分别出来的事物，而不只是古老。

abstract.en: A holy place asks people to lower their voices.
abstract.cn: 神圣之地会让人放低声音。

abstract.en: What we treat as holy shows what we worship.
abstract.cn: 我们视什么为神圣，就显示我们敬拜什么。

definition_en: the place where you live, or the place you belong
core_image: 傍晚窗口亮起的暖黄灯光
scene: 这所房子是我们的家。This house is our home.
sceneCN: 这里 home 是「家、住所」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这所房子是我们的家。

senses.title: The place you live
senses.definition: the place where you live
senses.definitionCN: 居住的地方
senses.example: This house is our home.
senses.exampleCN: 这所房子是我们的家。
senses.why: This is the basic everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的日常义项。

senses.title: The place you belong
senses.definition: the town or country you come from
senses.definitionCN: 出生或成长的地方
senses.example: She returned to her home in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 她回到了北方的家乡。
senses.why: Here the word means origin, not just a building.
senses.whyCN: 这里指根源，而不只是一栋房子。

senses.title: To or at the place you live
senses.definition: to or at your own place
senses.definitionCN: 回到或待在自己居住的地方
senses.example: He went home after the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 会后他回家了。
senses.why: As an adverb it needs no preposition.
senses.whyCN: 作副词时不需要介词。

intro.en: Home is an old Germanic word for a dwelling and the village around it.
intro.cn: home 是古老的日耳曼语词，指住所及周围的村落。

items.en: Haim meant a village or dwelling.
Home meant the place one lives.
It also became an adverb, as in go home.
items.cn: 它又成为副词，如 go home。

note.en: Home is compared with look-alike words and with words for a dwelling.
note.cn: 把 home 与形近词以及表示住所的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Home is more than a roof; it is where you belong.
normalIntro.cn: home 不只是一片屋顶，而是你归属的地方。

normal.en: This house is our home.
normal.cn: 这所房子是我们的家。

normal.en: He went home after the meeting.
normal.cn: 会后他回家了。

normal.en: She returned to her home in the north.
normal.cn: 她回到了北方的家乡。

normal.en: The smell of home cooking filled the room.
normal.cn: 房间里飘着家常菜的香味。

normal.en: I feel at home in this small town.
normal.cn: 我在这个小镇感到自在。

abstract.en: Home is a direction the heart keeps pointing to.
abstract.cn: 家是心一直指向的方向。

abstract.en: A house can be sold, but home cannot be moved.
abstract.cn: 房子可以卖掉，家却搬不走。

abstract.en: We leave home to learn what home means.
abstract.cn: 我们离开家，才懂得家的含义。

examples.en: This house is our home.
examples.cn: 这所房子是我们的家。

examples.en: He went home after the meeting.
examples.cn: 会后他回家了。

examples.en: I feel at home in this small town.
examples.cn: 我在这个小镇感到自在。

dict_mnemonic.text: home 是「家」，也可作副词表示「回家」，如 go home；hometown 是家乡，homework 是家庭作业。

root: 来自古英语 ham（住所、村庄），与德语 Heim 同源，后引申为家乡与归属之地。

sensesIntro.en: Home means the place you live, the place you come from, or the act of going there.
sensesIntro.cn: home 表示居住的地方、出生的家乡，也可作副词表示回家。

branches.en: This house is our home.
branches.cn: 这所房子是我们的家。

branches.en: She returned to her home in the north.
branches.cn: 她回到了北方的家乡。

branches.en: He went home after the meeting.
branches.cn: 会后他回家了。

branches.en: The noun and the adverb point to one place.
branches.cn: 名词和副词指向同一个地方。

branches.en: The smell of home cooking filled the room.
branches.cn: 房间里飘着家常菜的香味。

intro.en: Home builds homework, homeland, and homeless.
intro.cn: home 可构成 homework、homeland 和 homeless。

latinIntro.en: Home is Germanic, so its oldest forms come from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: home 属于日耳曼语，其最古老的形式来自古英语。

items.exampleCN: 暴风雨毁坏了许多房屋。
收容所帮助无家可归的人。

items.meaning: a person who owns a home

items.example: The room was small and homely.
The town held a homecoming parade.

latinEntries.example: Ham is the Old English source of home.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ham 是 home 的古英语来源。

definition_en: school work that students do at home
core_image: 台灯下一页写到一半的练习本
scene: 她晚饭前做完了家庭作业。She finished her homework before dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 homework 是「家庭作业」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她晚饭前做完了家庭作业。

senses.title: School work at home
senses.definition: school work that is done at home
senses.definitionCN: 带回家完成的学校功课
senses.example: She finished her homework before dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 她晚饭前做完了家庭作业。
senses.why: This is the main everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的日常义项。

senses.title: Preparation done in advance
senses.definition: study or research done before an event
senses.definitionCN: 为某个活动提前做的研究准备
senses.example: The reporter did her homework before the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 记者在采访前做了准备工作。
senses.why: Here the word is figurative, not school work.
senses.whyCN: 这里是比喻用法，不是学校作业。

intro.en: Homework joins home and work into school work done at home.
intro.cn: homework 把 home 和 work 合成一体，指在家完成的学校功课。

items.en: Hoom and werk kept both senses.
items.cn: hoom 和 werk 保留了这两个含义。

items.en: Homework named school work done at home.
items.cn: homework 指在家完成的学校功课。

items.en: It also came to mean preparation.

note.en: Homework is compared with other compound work words and with words for tasks.
note.cn: 把 homework 与其他含 work 的复合词以及表示任务的词作比较。

entries.definition: a task given to a student

normalIntro.en: Homework is the work school sends home with you.
normalIntro.cn: homework 就是学校让你带回家做的工作。

normal.en: She finished her homework before dinner.
normal.cn: 她晚饭前做完了家庭作业。

normal.en: I have too much math homework tonight.
normal.cn: 我今晚的数学作业太多了。

normal.en: He handed in his homework on time.
normal.cn: 他按时交了作业。

normal.en: The reporter did her homework before the interview.
normal.cn: 记者在采访前做了准备工作。

normal.en: Turn off the television and do your homework.
normal.cn: 关掉电视，去做作业。

abstract.en: Homework is practice given a quiet room.
abstract.cn: 家庭作业，是给练习安排了一间安静的房间。

abstract.en: What we do alone shows what we learned.
abstract.cn: 独处时做的事，显示我们学到了什么。

abstract.en: Even hard work can become a habit of care.
abstract.cn: 即使是苦功，也能变成一种用心的习惯。

examples.en: She finished her homework before dinner.

sensesIntro.en: Homework means school work done at home, or preparation done before an event.
sensesIntro.cn: homework 指在家完成的学校功课，也可指为某件事提前做的准备。

branches.en: She finished her homework before dinner.

branches.en: Turn off the television and do your homework.
branches.cn: 关掉电视，去做作业。

intro.en: Homework is a compound of home and work, like housework and coursework.
intro.cn: homework 是 home 与 work 的复合词，和 housework、coursework 构词相同。

latinIntro.en: Both parts are Germanic: home from Old English ham and work from weorc.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部分都属日耳曼语：home 来自古英语 ham，work 来自 weorc。

items.exampleCN: 这个项目需要团队合作。

items.example: The works is near the river.

latinEntries.example: Ham is the first part of homework.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ham 是 homework 的第一部分来源。

latinEntries.example: Weorc is the source of work.
latinEntries.exampleCN: weorc 是 work 的来源。

definition_en: made of parts that are all the same kind
core_image: 一整块颜色均匀的木头，看不出拼接的痕迹
scene: 这个班的学生水平比较整齐。The class is fairly homogeneous in level.
sceneCN: 这里 homogeneous 是「同质的、成分一致的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这个班的学生水平比较整齐。

senses.title: All of one kind
senses.definition: made of parts of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 由同一种类的部分构成
senses.example: The class is fairly homogeneous in level.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班的学生水平比较整齐。
senses.why: This is the core sense of sameness in kind.
senses.whyCN: 这是「种类相同」的核心义项。

senses.title: Evenly mixed
senses.definition: mixed so that the parts are evenly spread
senses.definitionCN: 混合后各部分分布均匀
senses.example: The mixture is homogeneous after stirring.
senses.exampleCN: 搅拌后混合物变得均匀。
senses.why: Here the focus is even distribution.
senses.whyCN: 这里强调的是分布均匀。

intro.en: Homogeneous joins Greek homos, same, with genos, kind.
intro.cn: homogeneous 由希腊语 homos（相同）与 genos（种类）组合而成。

items.en: Homogeneus meant of the same kind.
It spread to society and data.
items.cn: 它又扩展到社会与数据领域。

note.en: Homogeneous is compared with look-alike words and with words for sameness.
note.cn: 把 homogeneous 与形近词以及表示相同的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Homo means same and genos means kind, so homogeneous is same-kind.
normalIntro.cn: homo 是相同，genos 是种类，homogeneous 就是同种类的。

normal.en: The class is fairly homogeneous in level.
normal.cn: 这个班的学生水平比较整齐。

normal.en: The mixture is homogeneous after stirring.
normal.cn: 搅拌后混合物变得均匀。

normal.en: The town has a culturally homogeneous population.
normal.cn: 这个镇的人口在文化上比较单一。

normal.en: The data set is largely homogeneous.
normal.cn: 这组数据大体上是同质的。

normal.en: A homogeneous group is easier to survey.
normal.cn: 同质群体更容易做调查。

abstract.en: Homogeneous means the parts forgot they were separate.
abstract.cn: 同质，就是各部分忘了自己曾经分开。

abstract.en: Uniformity is comforting and also a little blind.
abstract.cn: 整齐令人安心，也有点盲目。

abstract.en: Difference is what a homogeneous surface hides.
abstract.cn: 差异，往往被均匀的表面藏起来。

examples.en: The class is fairly homogeneous in level.

examples.en: The town has a culturally homogeneous population.

sensesIntro.en: Homogeneous means made of one kind, or evenly mixed throughout.
sensesIntro.cn: homogeneous 表示由同一种类构成，或各部分均匀一致。

core.cn: 共属同一种类的各部分。

branches.en: Sameness in kind makes an even mixture.

branches.en: The data set is largely homogeneous.
branches.cn: 这组数据大体上是同质的。

intro.en: Homogeneous builds homogeneity and homogenize.
intro.cn: homogeneous 可构成 homogeneity 和 homogenize。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek genos, kind, through Medieval Latin homogeneus.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是希腊语 genos（种类），经中世纪拉丁语 homogeneus 而来。

items.exampleCN: 这项研究测量了同质性。

latinEntries.example: Homos is the first element of homogeneous.

latinEntries.example: Genos also gave English gene.

latinEntries.example: Homogeneus led to English homogeneous.
latinEntries.exampleCN: homogeneus 演变为英语的 homogeneous。

definition_en: telling the truth and not cheating
core_image: 一个人把捡到的钱包原封不动交还失主
scene: 他是个诚实的人，从不撒谎。He is an honest man and never lies.
sceneCN: 这里 honest 是「诚实的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他是个诚实的人，从不撒谎。

senses.title: Truthful in character
senses.definition: always telling the truth and not stealing
senses.definitionCN: 一贯说真话、不欺骗
senses.example: He is an honest man and never lies.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个诚实的人，从不撒谎。
senses.why: This is the central moral sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的道德义项。

senses.title: Open in speech
senses.definition: saying what you really think
senses.definitionCN: 说出真实想法，不绕弯子
senses.example: Give me an honest answer.
senses.exampleCN: 给我一个坦率的回答。
senses.why: Here the focus is openness, not morals.
senses.whyCN: 这里强调的是坦率，而不是品德。

intro.en: Honest comes from Latin honor, honor, through French.
intro.cn: honest 来自拉丁语 honor（荣誉），经法语进入英语。

items.cn: honest 意为可敬且诚实的。
honest 最终固定为诚实的含义。

note.en: Honest is compared with look-alike words and with words for truthfulness.
note.cn: 把 honest 与形近词以及表示真诚的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Honest people hold honor as more valuable than advantage.
normalIntro.cn: 诚实的人把荣誉看得比利益更可贵。

normal.en: He is an honest man and never lies.
normal.cn: 他是个诚实的人，从不撒谎。

normal.en: Give me an honest answer.
normal.cn: 给我一个坦率的回答。

normal.en: She made an honest mistake.
normal.cn: 她犯了一个无心的错误。

normal.en: To be honest, I do not like the plan.
normal.cn: 说实话，我不喜欢这个计划。

normal.en: He earns his money by honest work.
normal.cn: 他靠正当劳动挣钱。

abstract.en: Honest is a habit, not a single choice.
abstract.cn: 诚实是一种习惯，而不是一次选择。

abstract.en: The truth costs less than the lie that hides it.
abstract.cn: 真相的代价，比掩盖它的谎言更小。

abstract.en: An honest word can be both kind and hard.
abstract.cn: 诚实的话，可以既温和又难听。

examples.en: He is an honest man and never lies.
examples.cn: 他是个诚实的人，从不撒谎。

examples.en: Give me an honest answer.
examples.cn: 给我一个坦率的回答。

examples.en: To be honest, I do not like the plan.
examples.cn: 说实话，我不喜欢这个计划。

sensesIntro.en: Honest means truthful by character or open in what you say.
sensesIntro.cn: honest 表示为人诚实，或说话坦率。

branches.en: A truthful person also speaks openly.
branches.cn: 诚实的人说话也坦率。

branches.en: She made an honest mistake.
branches.cn: 她犯了一个无心的错误。

intro.en: Honest builds honesty and honestly, and takes dis- to become dishonest.
intro.cn: honest 可构成 honesty 和 honestly，加前缀 dis- 变成 dishonest。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin honor, honor.

abstract.cn: 力量信任骑手时，才最能载我们前行。

examples.en: The horse ran across the field.
examples.cn: 那匹马在田野里奔跑。

examples.en: She learned to ride a horse at ten.
examples.cn: 她十岁时学会了骑马。

examples.en: A wild horse stood on the hill.
examples.cn: 一匹野马站在山岗上。

dict_mnemonic.text: horse 是「马」，horse racing 是赛马，dark horse 是黑马；horsepower 是马力，horseback 是马背。

root: 来自古英语 hors，与德语 Ross 同源，是日耳曼语中表示马的古老词。

sensesIntro.en: Horse means the large riding animal, or a padded vaulting device in gymnastics.
sensesIntro.cn: horse 表示供人骑乘的马，也可指体操中的跳马器械。

core.en: The animal that carries and runs.

branches.en: The horse ran across the field.
branches.cn: 那匹马在田野里奔跑。

branches.en: A wild horse stood on the hill.
branches.cn: 一匹野马站在山岗上。

branches.en: He bet on a dark horse in the race.
branches.cn: 他在比赛中押了一匹黑马。

branches.en: The gymnast jumped over the horse.
branches.cn: 体操运动员跳过了跳马。

branches.en: An animal and a gym device share one shape.
branches.cn: 动物与体操器械共享一种形状。

intro.en: Horse builds horseback, horseman, and horsepower.
intro.cn: horse 可构成 horseback、horseman 和 horsepower。

latinIntro.en: Horse is Germanic, so its oldest forms come from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: horse 属于日耳曼语，其最古老的形式来自古英语。
